question: What does the most recent news article on proteinatlas.org report: which journal was the study published in, who led the team, and what did they identify?

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"site:proteinatlas.org/news most recent news article Human Protein Atlas"}

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"proteinatlas.org news \"Human Protein Atlas\" latest news article"}

turns.text:
The most recent news article on the Human Protein Atlas reports that the study was published in **_Protein Science_**. It was led by the **Human Protein Atlas research team**, and the researchers identified and characterized a **multiplex tissue resource containing high-resolution, single-cell protein-expression data**—covering **1,106 proteins across eight antibody panels and nine tissue settings**. The resource links protein localization with cell identity, tissue organization, cellular state, and subcellular structure.  

Source: https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-08-27/the-multiplex-tissue-resource-provides-deeper-spatial-insight-into-protein-expression
